name: m2t5a
description: Melee duel fixture on an open all-grass field: two player-one militias attack-move across the map against two idle player-two militias holding mirrored positions north and south. Each marcher acquires its nearest enemy inside aggro (= sight) range, pauses the march with an Attack head, closes to melee range and trades 4-damage blows on the 60-tick reload cadence; each defender auto-retaliates on first blood and keeps fighting until death. Ascending-eid strike order lets both attackers land their tenth (killing) blow before the defenders' ninth retaliation lands, so the duel ends with two corpses, two wounded survivors at 1 hp bar of 4, released engagements and no orphan claims. Milestone digests land every 30th tick plus final; the run doubles as the extended determinism canary.
